verdict.rationale: Qodo exposes a CLI and MCP-based 'Agentic Toolbox' that lets agents review changes, retrieve findings/rules, and apply fixes programmatically (qodo-docs-4..7, qodo-probe-3/4, qodo-probe-rt-1), which covers core review workflows outside the UI. However, there is no public REST/OpenAPI (qodo-probe-2 shows 404s), and no evidence that governance dashboards, org/repo configuration, blast-radius tagging, or history views (qodo-docs-8/10/14/15) are accessible programmatically, so UI-to-API parity is far from complete. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API/OpenAPI spec, programmatic access to governance/config/dashboard features, and independent confirmation of full parity.
